BUCKET.VECTOR.summary: Searches a bucket for the documents most similar to a query vector.
BUCKET.VECTOR.complexity: Depends on the size of the vector index and the search parameters.

reply_schema.description: The nearest documents, ordered by score.

score.description: The similarity score of the document.

entry.description: The document encoded as BSON bytes or a JSON string. The encoding follows the session's reply_type attribute.

arguments.name: bucket
arguments.summary: The name of the bucket to search.

arguments.name: selector
arguments.summary: The field that holds the vector index.

arguments.name: vector
arguments.summary: The query vector. Its length must match the dimensions of the index.

arguments.name: expression
arguments.summary: A filter expression applied to the hits after the similarity search.

arguments.name: spec
arguments.summary: A projection spec that selects the fields to return.

arguments.name: count
arguments.summary: The number of hits to return. Must not be negative. Defaults to 10.

arguments.name: threshold
arguments.summary: The lowest score a hit may have. Defaults to 0.0.

arguments.name: count
arguments.summary: The highest number of candidates the search may examine. Must be positive. Defaults to the server setting.

arguments.name: multiplier
arguments.summary: A multiplier on TOP for the number of candidates the traversal examines. Must be 1.0 or higher. Defaults to the server setting.
